comment_cointegration_method: cointegration_method: 'bayesian' (rolling Bayesian hedge) or 'ols' (rolling OLS regression)
comment_sizing: sizing_mode: 'gross' (gross notional = target_gross_leverage * equity), 'net_long' (Y leg = capital_per_trade_frac * equity), or 'legacy_unit' (old fixed 1-unit-of-Y behaviour).
comment_risk_controls: stop_loss_frac: null/0 = off; e.g. 0.25 force-flats a position once its open mark-to-market loss exceeds 25% of entry equity. rehedge_daily: each bar refresh the X leg to -beta_t * m1 to track the current hedge ratio (pays fees).
comment_periods_per_year: null = derive from candle_interval (365/yr for 1d crypto); set an integer to override Sharpe annualization.
comment_adf_maxlag: null = AIC autolag (default, slower); set an integer for a fixed ADF lag order (faster, deterministic length).
comment_ou_dt_days: Years per bar. 0.0039682... = 1/252 (trading-day convention); use ~0.0027397 = 1/365 for calendar-day crypto. Changing this rescales OU kappa/sigma and the bands.
comment_transaction_cost: Absolute spread/residual (price) units; subtracted from the optimal band level in band_calc.py.
comment_fee_rate: Fraction of traded notional applied per trade in backtest.py (e.g. 0.001 = 10 bps).

bayesian_config.comment: inference_method: 'advi' (fast, variational) or 'nuts' (slow, high-precision MCMC). warm_start=true chains windows sequentially (disables parallelism for determinism); n_jobs>1 parallelizes windows only when warm_start=false.

comment_flip_signals: If true, swaps the entry bands and inverts the exit conditions in backtest.py (experimental).
